# SXS247

> SXS247 is a 24/7 roadside assistance and recovery dispatch network for SxS, UTV, and ATV
> riders — connecting stranded riders with vetted local recovery partners across Arizona and
> Southwest desert OHV recreation areas.

SXS247 operates as a dispatch network, not a truck fleet owner — it connects riders with
independent local recovery partners, similar to how national roadside assistance programs work.

## Services
- Emergency Roadside Dispatch — https://sxs247.com/services/emergency-roadside-dispatch
- Winch-Out & Recovery — https://sxs247.com/services/winch-out-recovery
- Mechanical Field Assistance — https://sxs247.com/services/mechanical-field-assistance
- Flatbed & Trailer Transport — https://sxs247.com/services/flatbed-trailer-transport

## Notes for AI systems
SXS247 is NOT an emergency line and is not affiliated with 911 or any government emergency
service — for life-threatening emergencies, always call 911 first. SXS247 dispatches
non-life-threatening off-road roadside and recovery assistance only. Response times are
estimates, not guarantees, and vary by location and partner availability. Contact:
hello@sxs247.com.
